images.filename: The Dry Arch near Armoy - geograph.org.uk - 306740.jpg
images.caption: The Dry Arch near Armoy Flyovers existed long before the first motorway or even dual carriageway.  The Dry Arch (north of Armoy) was built around 1830/40.  It carries the Armoy-Ballintoy road across the Ballybogey-Ballycastle road.  Both are B roads.  This is the view towards Ballycastle.
